description: Read the wired Freehand source and publish its strokes as graph JSON — the node id list plus every edge (from_node_id, to_node_id). Forwards the graph on.
instructions:
Wire a Freehand source into this node to publish the freehand drawing's STRUCTURE as JSON on `val-graph`:

{ "nodes": [{ "id": "n1", "x": 0, "y": 0 }, …],
  "edges": [{ "from_node_id": "n1", "to_node_id": "n2" }, …] }

Each stroke becomes a chain of nodes/edges. Node positions are METRES relative to the drawing centroid, so the JSON can be fed straight into a Network node to redraw it, or into the pure-value Graph nodes (Set Thickness, Merge Graph, Mitered Join, Graph to Openings) — freehand is already vector, so no raster Vectorise is needed.

The strokes are forwarded unchanged on the main output too, so this node can sit inline in a pipeline (e.g. Freehand → Freehand Geometry → Graph Reduce). Also publishes `val-nodeCount` / `val-edgeCount` for wiring into Math / Output.
